editor.ai.detectFloorPlanPrompt: Please detect the rooms, doors, and windows on this floor from the floor plan image and create them.
editor.ai.placeEntitiesPrompt: Please place the entities that do not yet have a position in the model in the appropriate rooms.
editor.backup.help: Complete configuration in one file: plan, levels, roofs, device positions, floor plan templates, uploaded artwork, and view settings. AI credentials are not included.
editor.common.name: Name
editor.common.tapOrDrag: Tap or drag into the model
editor.confirm.importBackup: Import backup? The current plan will be replaced (undo is available).
editor.confirm.resetAll: Reset all HomeTwin data? The plan, rooms, device positions, and floor plan templates will be deleted. You can only restore them afterward from a previously exported JSON file.
editor.device.ceilingMounted: Mounted on the ceiling ({height} m room height).
editor.device.mediaScreenHelp: Shows cover art, title, and app from a media player. When linked to a camera or image entity, it shows that image. Videos are not shown to keep rendering lightweight.
editor.entities.noneFree: No open entities match this filter.
editor.entities.placeWithAssistant: Ask the assistant to place them
editor.frame.linkHint: Link an image, camera, or media-player entity above under “Link”.
editor.frame.uploadHelp: Stays local in Home Assistant, up to 1600 px.
editor.facade.plinthHelp: Only the storey on the terrain gets a plinth. If its floor is raised, the plinth reaches down to the terrain.
editor.file.resetHelp: Resets all HomeTwin data (plan and floor plan templates) and shows the initial setup again. Entities and settings in Home Assistant remain unchanged.
editor.level.autoElevation: Calculate height automatically from the level below
editor.library.instructions: Drag into the model or tap (places it in the selected room). R rotates, Delete removes.
editor.opening.distancesHelp: Distances to the wall ends are shown in the model and can be typed in.
editor.roof.detailsPitchedOnly: Details are available for pitched roofs.
editor.roof.extraHelp: Give garages, carports, garden houses, or extensions their own roof: select a room → ‘Roof this room’, or draw one with the roof tool.
editor.roof.geometryHelp: In 2D, drag the corners; edge lengths appear along the edges.
editor.roof.rafterVisibilityHint: Rafter tails are only visible with an open soffit.
editor.roof.shedOrientation: The high side is at the back; rotate 180°.
editor.roof.shedOrientationExtra: The high side is at the back; rotate twice by 90°.
editor.roof.styleHelp: Sets the covering, pitch, overhangs, facade, wood details{form}. You can adjust everything individually afterward.
editor.roofItem.dragHelp: Drag directly on the roof in the 3D view.
editor.roofItem.linkHelp: The blind moves visibly and an open window is shown tilted. Tap it in view mode to move the blind.
editor.room.roofHelpOther: Give a garage, carport, or patio roof its own roof.
editor.room.roofHelpRoom: For an extension, garden house, or conservatory with its own roof.
editor.room.shapeHelp: {area} m² · {corners} corners. Wall lengths appear in the model and can be typed in. Drag a corner; drag a midpoint to add a corner; double-click a corner to remove it.
editor.selection.help: Dragging moves all selected objects together. Shift-click adds or removes items; in 2D, drag a selection box.
editor.screen.emptyHelp: Choose a media player, camera, or image entity to show content on this screen.
editor.screen.help: Cover art, title, and app from a media player, or the image from a camera/image entity.
editor.site.northHelp: 0° means north is at the top of the floor plan. Positive values rotate north clockwise.
editor.solar.powerHelp: The modules light up based on the current output.
editor.stairs.heightMismatch: Height {height} m; the distance to ‘{level}’ is {needed} m.
editor.stairs.help: Width × depth is the full footprint. If it rises the wrong way, use ‘Reverse direction’; use rotation below to orient it.
editor.stairs.metrics: {steps} steps · rise {rise} cm · tread {tread} cm · rule {rule} cm {warning}
editor.stairs.metricsWarning: (typical: rise ≤ 19 cm, rule 59–65 cm — change depth or shape)
editor.status.wallSnapTitle: Furniture meets walls; wall devices snap to the wall

editor.toolHint.window: Click a wall to place a window.
